PluginData.Author: Farvane Naval Systems
PluginData.Tooltip: Type hex colour codes into your paint gun palette.
PluginData.Description: Type #RRGGBB values into your paint gun palette from the colour wheel (middle-click a colour) or the plugin settings, preview the colour the game will store, and keep named presets for reuse across worlds, including a built-in SE2 Default preset to restore the stock palette. Uses the game's own palette update, so it changes only your own palette. Optional debug logging for troubleshooting.
